# Exact GPU twins

Every row is a (feature, backend) pair whose scores equal the CPU extractor's
bits. A parity-gate cell whose two sides are `cpu` or listed twins of the
feature is compared with tolerance 0 at `--precision max`. The rule for
listing a twin is in the [cross-backend gate guide](cross-backend-gate.md#exact-twins).

| Feature | Backend | ADR | Evidence |

| `adm` | `cuda` | [ADR-1416](../adr/1416-cuda-adm-cpu-row-rounding.md) | RTX 4090, --precision max: 2034 of 2034 outputs (Netflix 8 to 16 bit, 1080p checkerboards, BBB 4K 50 frames) identical to --backend cpu. |
| `adm` | `hip` | [ADR-1423](../adr/1423-hip-adm-cpu-row-rounding.md) | gfx1036, --precision max: 21 fixture pairs (Netflix 8 to 16 bit, 1080p checkerboards, BBB 4K 200 frames) identical to --backend cpu (6192 values with debug=true). |
